title: Memory Density by Weekday
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifelog:moment
| eval weekday=strftime(_time,"%A")
| stats count as memories by weekday
| sort - memories
description: Counts which weekdays generate the most life-log moments and which tend to pass with the least capture.
value: Weekday density reveals the cadence of memorable living and whether routines are swallowing certain days whole.
implementation: Extract weekday names from life-log moments and compare total memory counts across the week.
visualization: Bar chart of life-log memories by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which days of the week end up full of memorable moments and which ones blur past.
